blind.description: Two halves of a cracked spherical geode resting against one another. The exterior surface is a rough, bumpy brown stone shell. Inside, each half features a jagged amethyst-purple crystalline lining enclosing a cluster of faceted amber-yellow crystal points in the center. The geometry is solid and continuous, resting directly on the ground without an added plinth.
blind.from_above: Two touching circular halves of a hollow sphere, revealing rough brown outer edges, purple interior crystal linings, and central yellowish crystal clusters.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1/6 to 1/7 of the figure's height (roughly 9 to 11 inches tall), and about 1.2 to 1.5 feet wide across both halves combined.

notes: interior crystals are purple and amber-yellow rather than violet and rose
footprint proportion 1.64x off the catalog (2.0 x 1.2 ft)
